name: Rubber Stamp
summary: Approve and Reject buttons that are real rubber stamps: they ink up, slam down and leave a rough mark
about: A finance desk with a pile of four expense claims in PKR and two wooden stamps beside a two-colour ink pad. Pressing a stamp makes it squat, lift out of the rack, dip into its ink, turn over the claim and slam down so the paper jolts and ink specks fly, then lift away to show a grainy APPROVED or REJECTED mark. The claim slides off to its pile, the next one drops in and the approved total counts up.
how: Press Approve or Reject (or Tab to one and press Enter) to stamp the claim on the desk.
Watch the stamp ink up, land and fly home; the claim then slides away and the next one drops in.
Read the running totals at the top: approved count and PKR sum, rejected and claims left.
After the last claim, press Start over to get four new claims.
